name: Tuolumne County Gyros
notes: As close to the real thing as you can get in TC!

items: 2¾+ cups flour (can do half whole wheat)
1⅛ cups warm water (may need to add just a bit more to get a pliable dough)
1 lb ground beef or ground turkey

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.body: Mix dry ingredients (**2¾+ cups flour**, **1 tsp salt** and **2 tsp yeast**). Add wet (**1 Tbsp olive oil**, **1 tsp honey** and **1⅛ cups warm water**, may need to add just a bit more to get a pliable dough). Mix and knead for 5 min.

steps.title: Heat the cookie sheets
steps.body: Put two large cookie sheets in the oven, and heat to 450°F.

steps.title: Shape the discs
steps.body: Press dough down and form **9 discs**. Roll each disc out to about a 7” circle.

steps.title: Bake the pita
steps.body: Place on hot cookie sheets about two at a time. Bake for 4–5 minutes per batch. They should puff up beautifully.

steps.title: Cook the meat
steps.body: Mix **1 lb ground beef or ground turkey**, **1½ tsp oregano**, **1 tsp garlic powder**, **1 tsp onion powder**, **1 tsp salt** and **¾ tsp pepper**. Form into patties and broil. Then cut patties into ¼–½” slices.

steps.title: Assemble the gyros
steps.body: Serve meat slices in pita bread (folded like tacos), topped with tomato, onion, lettuce, and sauce.
